newsitem.title: UK: Handcuffed British convicts hijack prison bus.
newsitem.headline: Handcuffed British convicts hijack prison bus.

text.p: British police were searching for six escaped convicts on Tuesday after they overpowered their five guards while wearing handcuffs and hijacked a prison bus on a busy London motorway.
The director of security of the Prison Service described the embarrassing escape as a "regrettable and extremely serious incident" and ordered a full investigation.

Helicopters and sniffer dogs were being used to track down the men who were being transferred to jails in the capital when they hijacked the bus to a secluded street in north London where they fled, watched by pupils from a nearby school.
"The coach driver was handcuffed and he said to me and my friend "Help, help - can you get the head mistress'," one of the pupils told reporters.
Police described the convicts, all serving between eight to 12 year sentences, as dangerous and warned the public to be cautious.
Four of the five guards were treated in hospital for their injuries.
